text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started — env: prod, service: infer-runtime, tag: release-2.2.0, commit: 3f7b1a2. Rolling 4 instances. Change window: emergency (out-of-band). ⏳
katy: Noted, tracking in release notes. @sam are you watching?
sam: On it, I'll tail logs and open a dashboard tab.
release-ci: Smoke tests started: /smoke/infer-runtime — 10 checks running.
ryan: seeing a spike in 5xx from canary (last 20s). probable mem spike after commit 3f7b1a2. suggest we pause.
katy: Pause rollout. Can we rollback to release-2.1.9 immediately?
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by katy. Current canary: 2/4 updated. To continue rollout react :white_check_mark: To rollback react :arrows_counterclockwise:.
aisha: Reacting with :arrows_counterclockwise: — initiating rollback now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by @aisha — reverting to tag release-2.1.9 (commit: b7d9c4e). Reason: increased 5xx observed in canary. ETA ~3m. Traces: https://redwood.internal/traces/abcd1234
sam: I'll keep tails on logs and alerting. If stable after rollback we should pin 2.1.9 until hotfix.
ryan: creating hotfix branch: `hotfix/2.2.0-memfix` — will open a PR with OOM guard + reduced batch size.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed — elapsed 2m42s. All canaries reverted to release-2.1.9. Production routing restored. Incident tag: rollback-1768503140.
katy: Thanks. Pinning release-2.1.9 for 24h to prevent automatic upgrades. @release-ci please add to release notes: 'Rollback — increased 5xx in release-2.2.0 canary, reverted to 2.1.9; investigating'.
release-ci: Note added to release tracker: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.2.0-incidents
aisha: I'll run a staging canary of the hotfix once PR is merged. cc @ryan
ryan: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/482 — review requested from @aisha. I'll monitor perf in staging.
katy: Filing postmortem checklist in #postmortems, assigning to @ryan and @sam. Change window owner will schedule patch rollout.
deploy-bot: Pin applied — release-2.1.9 pinned for 24h by katy. To change: `rdwctl release pin set release-2.1.9 --duration 72h`.
sam: Monitoring looks stable. 5xx returned to baseline. Good job everyone.
ryan: Thanks team — I'll prioritize the hotfix and run a dedicated canary before reattempting prod rollout.
